heading: Piotr Kielak is cosmically awesome
subheading: And I will tell you why. Let's go into the deep space to find out why
introText1: I'm a front-end developer with a few years of experience in web development. I always wanted to create unique and tailored experiences, and this page is one of them. It combines retro look with three.js to tell the story of going into space.
introText2: There's also my personal blog/digital garden, but I call it my own personal universe, if you want explore it, you can scroll down to the bottom of the page.
motivationText: As a software developer, I want to build useful apps and pages that leave a positive impact. I think this way I can change the world around for better. Some of my earlier projects comercial or private have succeeded in this misson, it keeps me motivated to keep going.
kopistaDescription: Kopista is a handwriting to markdown converter that lets you capture handwritten notes and convert them into markdown text.
universeHeading: And there it is, my own, personal universe...
universeSubheading: Navigate by clicking on the star representing the blog post/note.
